memories.content: The local's executive board met twice last week without issuing a statement. A rank-and-file caucus has been leafleting against the memorandum. The local has not yet decided whether to endorse the port automation memorandum or to issue a press release.

The international union endorsed a similar deal at another port last month. The local can issue a press release at any time before Monday. The port automation memorandum is a known topic of discussion.
